wargear.name: Vow of Silence
wargear.summary: Every Sister has sworn a vow of quiet, and the unit's presence is a cold hole in the warp.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Vow of Silence, enemy Psykers within 6" of that Unit subtract 1 from the result of every Psychic Check they make.

wargear.name: Oblivion-forged aegis
wargear.summary: A shield-plate wrought in the Throne Room's own foundries, hungry to unmake what strikes it.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Oblivion-forged aegis has an Invulnerable Save of 4+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Null-lattice hull
wargear.summary: The Acquisitor's hull is lined with a mesh of soulless iron, built for hauling the damned through the Black Ships' corridors.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Null-lattice hull adds 1 to its Front Armour Value.

wargear.name: Soul-dampener collar
wargear.summary: A choker of black iron that drinks the warp-light from the air around it.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Soul-dampener collar has the Dampening Pall Special Rule.

wargear.name: Null-iron rosary
wargear.summary: A string of beads cast from the black iron of the Palace dungeons.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Null-iron rosary has the Rosary of Quiet Special Rule.

wargear.name: Hushed bell
wargear.summary: A bell with no clapper that, when swung, rings only inside the mind.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Hushed bell has the Muting Toll Special Rule.

wargear.name: Verdict-seal manacles
wargear.summary: Warded iron cuffs bearing a sentence already pronounced.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Verdict-seal manacles has the Seal of Arrest Special Rule.

wargear.name: Cell-lock grapnels
wargear.summary: Spring-fed grapnels fired from the Acquisitor's flanks to snare running prey.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Cell-lock grapnels has the Snare Volley Special Rule.

wargear.name: Revealing lumen
wargear.summary: A hard white searchlight that strips cover and shadow from whatever it falls on.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Revealing lumen has the Truth Beam Special Rule.

wargear.name: Voidscale cloak
wargear.summary: A shimmering cloak that scatters the light of anything aimed at the wearer.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a voidscale cloak has an Invulnerable Save of 5+. Against Hits from Weapons with the Template or Blast Special Rules that save is 3+.

wargear.name: Voidsheen cloak
wargear.summary: A lighter cousin of the voidscale, worn by the Oblivion Knights and their Raptora.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a voidsheen cloak has an Invulnerable Save of 6+. Against Hits from Weapons with the Template or Blast Special Rules that save is 4+.

wargear.name: Distort field
wargear.summary: A field of bent light that makes the bearer seem further away than it is.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a distort field, the distance from an enemy Unit to that Unit is counted as 6" greater when measuring Range for Shooting Attacks. Models with the Primarch Type ignore this effect. Weapons with the Barrage (X) Special Rule always treat that Unit as out of Line of Sight when scattering. This does not stack with other effects that increase Range in the same way.

wargear.name: Spectra cloaks
wargear.summary: Cloaks of woven spectral thread that smear the wearer across the eye.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with spectra cloaks, the distance from an enemy Unit to that Unit is counted as 6" greater when measuring Range for Shooting Attacks. Weapons with the Template Special Rule and Models with the Primarch Type ignore this effect. Weapons with the Barrage (X) Special Rule always treat that Unit as out of Line of Sight when scattering. This does not stack with other effects that increase Range in the same way.

wargear.name: Excrutia armatus
wargear.summary: Armour that wears down the nerve of anyone who stands against its bearer.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with excrutia armatus, enemy Units cannot declare a Reaction in response to Shooting Attacks or Charges made by that Unit, unless the enemy Unit includes a Model with the Fearless or Stubborn Special Rule.

wargear.name: Erinyes jetbike
wargear.summary: A swift antigrav bike that carries the Sisters in silence to wherever the witch is hiding.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Erinyes jetbike also carries a snare cannon and has the Cavalry Type and the Antigrav Sub-Type, keeping any other Sub-Types it has. In a Battle Turn in which it Moved, it has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule; in a Battle Turn in which it Rushed, it has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule instead.

wargear.name: Compression tanks
wargear.summary: Pressurised fuel tanks that make a flamer burn hotter, once.
wargear.text: Once per battle, when the Controlling Player declares a Shooting Attack for a Unit that includes Models equipped with compression tanks, they may declare that the tanks are used. Every Model in that Unit with compression tanks must then use them: each adds 2 to the RS of its Weapons with the Flame Trait for that Shooting Attack. Once that Shooting Attack is resolved, all the Unit's compression tanks are spent.

rules.name: Silent Hunt
rules.summary: They do not shout. They do not speak. The witch notices only that her prayers have stopped working.
rules.text: While an enemy Psyker is within 12" of a Unit with this Special Rule, that Psyker subtracts 1 from its Willpower Characteristic.

rules.name: Oblivion Charge
rules.summary: Where witch-fire cannot reach, a blade can.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule may declare a Charge in the Battle Turn in which it Disembarks from a Transport. If an enemy Psyker or Malefic Unit is within that Unit's Charge reach, the Controlling Player must declare the Charge against one such Unit.

rules.name: Incorruptible Engines
rules.summary: A machine cannot be tempted, and a null cannot be reached.
rules.text: Enemy Psychic Powers cannot target a Model with this Special Rule, and such a Model is unaffected by the Corruption and Malefic abilities of enemy Models.

rules.name: Dampening Pall
rules.summary: The pall smothers the pains the witch would visit on those around the bearer.
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule cannot gain the Pinned, Stunned or Suppressed Tactical Status as the result of an enemy Psychic Power or Malefic ability.

rules.name: Rosary of Quiet
rules.summary: Black-iron beads, each one a small silence.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.

rules.name: Muting Toll
rules.summary: The bell rings only inside the mind, and what it rings out is the witch's own power.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the enemy Shooting Phase, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Unit within 18" of a Model with this Special Rule. Until the end of that phase, that Unit cannot use Psychic Weapons or the Force (X) Special Rule.

rules.name: Seal of Arrest
rules.summary: The sentence has already been pronounced.
rules.text: If a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule wins an Assault against a Unit that includes a Psyker or Malefic Model, that enemy Unit gains the Stunned Tactical Status.

rules.name: Snare Volley
rules.summary: The grapnels fly, and the quarry learns it cannot run.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the enemy Controlling Player's Movement Phase, choose one enemy Infantry Unit within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule. That Unit gains the Pinned Tactical Status.

rules.name: Truth Beam
rules.summary: A hard white light strips cover and shadow from whatever it falls on.
rules.text: Enemy Units within 24" of a Model with this Special Rule cannot use the Shrouded (X) or Infiltrate (X) Special Rules against that Model's Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Chamber of Vigilance
rules.summary: The Vigilance sit on the edge of the field long before anyone thinks to look for them.
rules.text: Before the first Battle Turn, before any Models are deployed, the Controlling Player of a Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule may choose for that Unit to gain either the Scout Special Rule or the Infiltrate (9) Special Rule until the end of the battle.

rules.name: Chamber of Judgement
rules.summary: The Judgement are drilled to stand over a witch and never look away.
rules.text: While a Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule is Locked in Combat with an enemy Unit that includes any Model with the Psyker Trait, those Models have the Fearless Special Rule.

rules.name: Chamber of Oblivion
rules.summary: The Oblivion are sent where the warp has already bled through, and fight on without flinching.
rules.text: While a Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule is Locked in Combat with an enemy Unit that includes any Model with the Malefic Sub-Type, those Models have the Fearless Special Rule.

rules.name: Fearless
rules.summary: Nothing in the enemy line can make this Unit step back.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule ignores the Fear (X) Special Rule. A Unit that includes any Model with this Special Rule cannot gain the Pinned or Routed Tactical Status.

rules.name: Stubborn
rules.summary: Hard to frighten, and harder to move.
rules.text: When a Unit that includes any Model with this Special Rule makes a Cool Check or a Panic Check, it ignores all negative modifiers to the Characteristic used. A Unit that also has the Fearless Special Rule uses that rule instead.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.summary: The Unit never slows to aim and never slows to strike.
rules.text: A Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule treats its Models as Stationary when making a Shooting Attack with a Weapon that has the Heavy (X) or Ordnance (X) Special Rule, even if they Moved earlier in the same Battle Turn. Such a Unit may also declare a Charge in a Battle Turn in which it made a Shooting Attack.

rules.name: Entangle (X)
rules.summary: Weighted nets and snare-charges bind the target where it stands.
rules.text: Wound Tests for Hits from a Weapon with this Special Rule compare the attack's Strength to the target's Strength Characteristic instead of its Toughness Characteristic. Wounds from such Hits are not allowed Saving Throws or Damage Mitigation Tests. Instead, for each of them, every Model in the Target Unit reduces its Movement Characteristic by X (to a minimum of 1) until the end of its Controlling Player's next Battle Turn, and the Wound is then discarded without reducing any Wounds Characteristic or removing any Model. Hits from this Special Rule are discarded against Models with the Vehicle or Primarch Type, and against Models with a Wounds Characteristic of 6 or more.

armyRules.name: Soulless Resolve
armyRules.flavor: The Sisters feel no warp-born dread, and give no warmth to it either.
benefits: An Anathema Model ignores the effects of the Fear (X) Special Rule and cannot gain a Tactical Status as the result of an enemy Psychic Power.
drawbacks: An Anathema Model cannot be targeted by friendly Psychic Powers, and cannot benefit from a Feel No Pain Special Rule granted by another Model.

armyRules.name: Quarry Marked
armyRules.flavor: A cadre hunts the gifted by sight.
benefits: A Null Sister adds 1 to her Hit Tests when she makes a Shooting Attack against a Unit that includes a Psyker or Malefic Model.
drawbacks: Against any other target more than 12" away, a Null Sister subtracts 1 from her Hit Tests.
armyRules.condition: when targeting a Psyker or Malefic unit

armyRules.name: Cell-Block Hold
armyRules.flavor: The Acquisitor is a moving prison, and smells like one.
benefits: Enemy Units that begin their move within 6" of an Acquisitor subtract 2" from the distance they move when they Rush.
drawbacks: An Acquisitor subtracts 2 from its Capacity Characteristic, its hold cramped by cells.

rites.name: Vow of the Silent Hunt
rites.flavor: They do not shout. They do not speak. The witch notices only that her prayers have stopped working.
benefits: Kharon Pattern Acquisitors may fill Troops slots.
Anathema, Prosecutor and Vigilator Cadres gain Infiltrate (9) and Silent Hunt: while an enemy Psyker is within 12" of a Cadre, it subtracts 1 from its Willpower Characteristic.
limitations: At least two Anathema, Prosecutor or Vigilator Cadres are required.

modifiers.text: Vow of the Silent Hunt: Infiltrate (9), Silent Hunt.

require.note: At least two Cadres take the vow.

rites.name: The Oblivion Knights Ride
rites.flavor: Even the Silent Sisterhood needs someone to carry a sword where the witch-fire cannot reach.
benefits: Knight-Centuras may fill Troops and Elites slots, and Oblivion Knights may fill Troops slots. Both gain Line (1) and add 1 to their Attacks Characteristic.
They gain Oblivion Charge: a Unit may declare a Charge in the Battle Turn in which it Disembarks from a Transport.
limitations: At least two Knight-Centuras or Oblivion Knights are required.
No Anathema, Prosecutor or Vigilator Cadres.
A Knight-Centura or Oblivion Knights Unit that can charge an enemy Psyker or Malefic Unit must do so.

modifiers.text: The Oblivion Knights Ride: +1 A, Line (1), Oblivion Charge.

require.note: At least two Oblivion Knights ride.

rites.name: The Black Ships' Writ
rites.flavor: When the Sisters cannot be everywhere, the Throne lends them machines that cannot be tempted.
benefits: Castellax Battle and Destructor Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Incorruptible Engines: enemy Psychic Powers cannot target them.
Anathema, Prosecutor and Vigilator Cadres gain Dampening Pall: they cannot gain the Pinned, Stunned or Suppressed Tactical Status as the result of an enemy Psychic Power or Malefic ability.
limitations: At least two Castellax Maniples are required.
No more than one Cadre of any kind.

modifiers.text: The Black Ships' Writ: Line (1), Incorruptible Engines.
The Black Ships' Writ: Dampening Pall.
